https://github.com/joemooney/aida-relay/pull/96
Exact OPEN draft head e5ebd063962e73c9567ec7697105fd520e712337 (normal push, origin/REST verified). Relay-local TASK-119 is Done on its branch, pending independent review and merge.

Every launched relay session now receives the selected CLI's explicitly reported --version as AIDA_HARNESS_VERSION from a bounded noninteractive probe; failed/blank/invalid detection clears inherited context. Native Bash byte/UTF-8 validation, capped output and whole-pipeline timeout preserve existing runner guards. No optional effort change, model inference or transcript parsing.

Final startup26 passed. All31 shell suites exercised: final discovery30 passed/1 audit failed before the last inventory fix; the complete affected slot suite passed after that fix, and startup26 passed again. No single all-green full-discovery run at final head, Rust runtime, clippy, or current-head CI-green claim. ShellCheck/fmt/diff passed. Three author checker passes; final checker26 startup+502 byte-oracle cases passed, no findings. One subsequent mechanical Bash-inventory registration was verified by complete slot-suite runtime. These checks provide zero independent review authority.

TASK-1793 remains incomplete. Its AIDA agent-new half #2710 stays draft/stacked until #2682 lands; #2682 is still OPEN at349e7f68d7. No author verdict/clearance/ship/main merge/install/activation/Completed. Please route relay#96 for independent review. Optional effort-column expansion remains excluded.
